Industry

🛍️ Ecom Communication Style
Choose how the assistant speaks and guides product discovery. This changes wording and question order only; categories, products, prices, specifications and media still come strictly from Ecom. Existing customers remain on their current behaviour until a style is selected and saved.
🎓 Education Communication Style
Choose how the assistant speaks with prospective students. This changes wording and discovery order only; course facts, prices and media still come strictly from the configured course catalogue.
👥 User Management
Invite teammates, view anyone's profile (Chatwoot login, module access, travel lead categories) — lives on its own 👥 User Management page.
🔔 Notification Email
Get emailed when a hot lead or human handover is detected. Requires SMTP setup in n8n notifications workflow.
🚨 SLA & Slack Alerts
Also post hot-lead, handover, and SLA-breach alerts to Slack (in addition to email). SLA minutes controls how long a lead can sit waiting for a human reply before it's flagged.
🧠 Objection Playbook
Approved response strategy per objection type — the bot follows this instead of a generic FAQ answer when it detects the objection. Leave any blank to fall back to a sensible default.
📋 Qualifying Questions & Native Forms
Questions the bot asks a brand-new lead before routing them into your funnel. Mark a question "optional" to let the customer skip it. Turn on Native Forms to collect all of these in a single WhatsApp form instead of asking them one at a time in chat.
💰 Deal Currency
Default currency stamped on each new lead's deal value (editable per lead in its detail view).
🧳 Services & Prices
Define your packages, tours, or services with prices. The bot will reference these when answering customer questions.
🔄 Cross-Sell & Upsell
Suggest a related product/service whenever a lead's conversation mentions a trigger keyword. Suggestions show up as one-click inserts in the lead's reply box, and as add-on prompts when building a quote/invoice.
📂 Knowledge Base
Upload PDFs, Word docs, or text files. The bot will read and reference this content when answering questions.

🛡️ Trust & Policies
Real answers for the objections that actually stall a sale — what happens if they want a refund, when delivery arrives, what cancelling costs. Grounds Deal Coach's recommendations so they're specific to your actual policies, not generic advice.
🛒 Auto Order-Tracking
Bot Persona & System Prompt
The bot's voice, scope, and guardrails. You can also override the defaults here for tone/style, reply length, stage pacing, closing style, and message format — e.g. "keep replies to 1-2 sentences", "never propose a next step, just answer the question", "use short paragraphs with line breaks". Anything you specify here takes priority over the built-in defaults. Ecommerce only: write the literal placeholder [ORDER_LINK] anywhere in your own scripted wording (e.g. "Order ചെയ്യാൻ ഇവിടെ ക്ലിക്ക് ചെയ്യൂ: [ORDER_LINK]") and it's automatically swapped for the real checkout link before sending — the bot will never send that placeholder text as-is.
Follow-up Messages
Every follow-up setting — the two nudges sent while still inside WhatsApp's 24-hour reply window, and the three template-based re-engagement sends at day 2/4/7 — now lives in one place: Campaigns → 💪 Follow-up Engine.
🧪 Test Mode
Bot only responds to your number when enabled.
🤝 Human Handover
Turn this off if you never want the bot escalating to a human at all — no "connecting you to our advisor" replies, no entries in the Human Deals queue, regardless of what a customer asks or how frustrated they sound. The bot answers everything itself instead. The Human Deals tab is hidden automatically while this is off, since there'd be nothing to triage there.
With handover on (above), the bot still keeps replying even after a lead is handed over to a human by default (e.g. outside business hours, or while waiting for a rep to pick up) — the lead still shows as handed over either way. Turn this on if you'd rather the bot go fully silent the moment a human takes over, so it can never talk over your team.
🤖 Bot Auto-Reply
Turn this off if you're running your own bot (e.g. a custom n8n workflow) wired to the same WhatsApp inbox and want it to own the replies instead. The CRM keeps working exactly as normal either way — leads, stages, analytics, and handover detection keep updating from the conversation; only this bot's own outgoing WhatsApp messages stop sending.
⏱️ Bot Reply Delay
Minimum gap the bot waits between replies to the same conversation, so a customer sending several messages in a row (or a redelivered webhook) doesn't get answered mid-burst. Raise this if 4 seconds feels too aggressive for how your customers message; lower it if replies feel sluggish. Any message that arrives before the gap has elapsed is silently skipped, not queued — it's answered by whichever later message the customer sends once the gap has passed.
🔘 Quick-Reply Buttons
When on, the bot offers tappable WhatsApp buttons (or a scrollable list, for more than 3 options) wherever it would otherwise ask the customer to pick from a few choices — e.g. which product variant they want, or a one-tap "Talk to a human" alongside an objection reply. Turn this off if you'd rather the bot always reply with plain text instead.
Conversation Stages
Exact messages the bot sends at each stage — sent only when the customer gives a genuine reply that moves the conversation forward (e.g. "yes", a booking time), never mixed into an answer to a question. Keep these generic ("Would you like to see pricing?") rather than naming a specific product or service — if you sell multiple, the bot already pulls in live details for whichever one the customer is actually asking about when they ask, from your Products/Services data. A stage message naming one specific product will read oddly to a customer asking about a different one.

Order placed, payment received, shipped and delivered all notify over WhatsApp automatically — Shopify webhooks were registered on your store the moment you connected, nothing to paste in manually. Webhook endpoint (for reference/debugging only):
Shopify Notifications
Sent via your connected WhatsApp Business number straight through Meta's Graph API — no Chatwoot or n8n dependency. Connect WhatsApp under Settings → Channels first.
How it works:
• Shopify order created → sends the Order Received template
• Order marked paid → sends the Payment Received template
• Fulfillment created (shipping label/tracking added) → sends the Order Shipped template
• Carrier reports delivered → sends the Order Delivered template (best-effort — only carriers Shopify tracks natively report this)
• Checkout abandoned for 60+ minutes with no order → sends the Abandoned Cart template (checked every 20 min)

Don't have a template yet for one of these? Order Received, Payment Received and Order Shipped each have a ⚡ Use Meta Library Template button — creates one of Meta's own pre-approved templates, no review wait, but you'll need to map its variables below afterward. Every event also has a ✨ Create Suggested Template button that submits custom wording instead — usually approved within a few hours, and its variables are already mapped for you.

📖 Public Booking Page
Share this link with customers so they can request an appointment themselves — no Cal.com or other account needed. Requests land in your Appointments tab as "requested" for you to confirm. Paste it into your bot's prompt, WhatsApp bio, website, wherever.
🗓️ Cal.com Sync (optional)
Already using Cal.com for scheduling? Connect it so bookings made there show up in your Appointments module automatically — no manual entry. In Cal.com: Settings → Developer → Webhooks → Add, paste the URL below as the endpoint, choose "Booking Created" and "Booking Cancelled" events, and set a secret (paste the same secret in both places).
✉️ Resend (Email)
Used by the Bulk Marketing module to send email campaigns from your own verified sending domain. Use a sending-only (restricted) Resend API key, not a full-access one.
📈 Meta Ads (Conversions API)
Reports lead quality (captured → qualified/disqualified → booked) back to Meta so your ad campaigns optimize for real conversions, not just chat volume. Get a Pixel ID and access token from Events Manager → Data Sources → your Pixel → Settings → Conversions API.
Conversions API only ever sends events to Meta — it can't report spend back. Ad spend needs Meta's separate Marketing API, which uses this Ad Account ID plus the same token above (it needs the ads_read permission too — check this under the token's System User in Business Settings if the ROI report shows "not connected"). The 🤖 Ads Automation tab (Reports page) also reuses this same token, but needs ads_management as well — required to create/sync audiences and change campaign budgets.

🎙️ Voice
🎙️ Voice-to-Voice Reply
When a customer sends a voice note, the bot can reply with a voice note back instead of text — same language as the customer, spoken naturally, with any link or price sent as a short text note alongside it instead of being read aloud.
🔧 TTS Provider (testing)
Which text-to-speech engine voice-to-voice replies and voice follow-ups use for this client. Leave on Auto for normal operation. "Gemini Live" and "Piper" are optional alternative voice engines — enable one here to try it for this client only. Piper is free and local but English-only by default.
🔁 Voice Follow-ups
When this is on, scheduled follow-up and win-back messages (the Follow-ups tab's sequence and the automated recovery ladder) go out as a spoken voice note too, in the same natural voice and language as live voice-to-voice replies — not just plain text. Falls back to text automatically if voice generation fails for a given message, so a follow-up is never skipped over a voice hiccup.
🗺️ Advanced Pipeline Follow-ups
Whenever a lead's Stage changes, automatically queues a follow-up task in Task Manager so no lead sits without a next action — escalating Day 1 → Day 3 → Day 7 → Day 14 → monthly, tagged by mode (text → voice note → video) and, if a lead never replies to either of the first two, flagged "cold" with the channel switched to a phone call then email.
